name: No Code-Shader
summary: Free library of remixable WebGL shader scenes built with Unicorn Studio.
description: Library of WebGL shader templates and interactions made in Unicorn Studio by Hardik Bhansali: browse and preview shaders, remix them through remix links, study the internal structure of each effect and watch behind-the-scenes videos. The library is free with no paywall; custom shader scenes start at $999 USD.
contains: remix links with the internal structure of each effect
free to browse, preview and remix, no paywall
